transcript:
Agent: AI Chauffeur, the premium reservation system for limousine, black car and chauffeured transportation. This is the demo line. Play the customer and request a trip. Calls are recorded and transcribed. Which trip would you like to try — airport, point to point, or by the hour.
User: I would like to book a ride to the airport tomorrow. 
Agent: Pickup address, pickup time, and which airport?
User: Actually, what can you do for me? I own a limo company. 
Agent: You run a limo company, got it. AI Chauffeur answers your phone line for you, twenty-four seven, under your company name. It takes new trip requests, collects all the details, and sends the trip sheet to your dispatch by text and email, with the call recording and transcript. Your team handles confirming, availability, changes, and payment. What else would you like to know?
User: Does it answer under my company name? 
Agent: Yes, it answers every call under your company name, just like your own team would. Anything else you want to know?
User: Can it send my dispatcher the trip? 
Agent: Yes, after every new trip call, your dispatcher gets the trip sheet, the call recording, and the full transcript. You can have it sent by text, by email, or both—however you want. What else would you like to know?
User: I would like to set up a time. 
Agent: Name, company, and best number?
User: [caller], [caller]. 
Agent: That's [caller]. Is that right?
User: Yes. 
Agent: How did you hear about us?
Agent: Take your time. I'll be right here.
User: The first one. 
Agent: Okay to text the confirmation to that number?
User: Google. 
Agent: The next open times are today at 2:30 Central and today at 3 Central — which works?
User: Thanks. Goodbye. 
Agent: Thank you for calling. You can always find us at A I chauffeur dot A I. Goodbye.
